RagShortTexts: The Poitiers-Antioch dynasty under Bohemond VI gambled on alliance with Mongol Hulagu Khan.

Variants.Content: Uniting the Principality of Antioch and County of Tripoli, the House of Poitiers-Antioch steered northern Outremer through high-stakes diplomacy. Influenced by his father-in-law King Hetoum of Armenia, Prince Bohemond VI allied directly with Ilkhanate Mongol leader Hulagu, aiding the capture of Aleppo and Damascus.
While vassalage to the Mongols secured territorial recoveries, it alienated the papal curia in Rome and marked Antioch as the primary target for retributive Mamluk jihads.
Frankish knights and Mongol horsemen walk the same bazaars in Antioch. Yet veteran guards know that if the Ilkhan withdraws across the Euphrates, Mamluk vengeance will be merciless.
